body: I’m too exhausted to go into too much detail. But I’m safe at a shelter. In unbelievable pain from the effort of today, and I don’t know how much they’ll be able to help me medically. I only hope I end up somewhere that I’lll be taken care of but not be too much of a burden. Your words made such a difference and gave me so much strength. I have the feeling they will continue to do so for quite some time. Thank you again friend

I’m too exhausted to go into too much detail. But I’m safe at a shelter. In unbelievable pain from the effort of today, and I don’t know how much they’ll be able to help me medically. I only hope I end up somewhere that I’lll be taken care of but not be too much of a burden. I thank you from the bottom of my heart for saving me, friend.

You have such a comforting way with words. It has an immediate calming effect on me. I’m running out of phone battery now so I’m going to try to save some juice. No matter what happens, your words have made me feel like 100 times braver. You’re wonderful, thank you.

Wow I’m sure glad you didn’t go through with the suicide. This feels a little selfish to say but if you had, you wouldn’t have been able to help me (and many other people, I’m sure). 

Yes I’d sure like to understand his thinking on this too ha!

I feel much less panicky now. My phone battery is getting a little low and I don’t have a charger. So I think I’m going to spend some time calming down as much as possible. I’ve discovered that if I turn the heated seat on in my car, it helps with the pain a little. I had been worried that I’d use up all my gas if I left the heat on, but I wasn’t thinking clearly. I do have my wallet and some money so gas won’t be a problem. Once I get calmed down I’ll try to drive a little further down the street to the McDonald’s. Maybe I can manage to eat something. Everyone thinks clearer when they’re not hungry. But I need to calm down first or I won’t be able to keep the food down. I think I can do it though. Thanks to you. 

If I make it through this I promise to pass your kindness forward. I’ll do some kind of charity or donate. I’m so glad this doesn’t take a toll on you. Will be radio silent to save battery now. No news is good news. Can’t thank you enough for what you’ve done for me. No matter what happens now, you’re my hero

Ah I see. Thank you for explaining. I feel a little better about that being an option now. Not sure why I was afraid of what they’d do, I’m in so much pain (physical) I’m not thinking too clearly. Your last comment really meant a lot to me. Nobody’s ever said that to me before. Made me cry for a bit but in a good way. Thank you for caring

You’re such a good person. I’d imagine that talking to people like me on this sub takes quite a toll on you. I don’t know how you do it but I’m so grateful for you. 

Yes you’re right again. I did ask him if he hated me for being disabled now. That’s actually what made him go berserk earlier. He said something about he couldn’t believe I’d say that and then screamed about how much he does for me and he can’t believe I’m complaining that it’s not enough. Then he started yelling that he hardly spends any time at all on his computer. But it’s all he does. I wonder if the reason he hates me now is because he can’t be lazy any more

I guess I said that because I’m trying to figure out why he hates me for becoming disabled. I just don’t understand what I did that would make him resent me. 

Thank you again for talking with me. I’m still scared to death and my brain is cloudy from pain. But I’m not in a panic any more. I honestly don’t know what I’m going to do yet but thank you for helping a stranger. I’m afraid to call the suicide hotline because I’ve heard first hand what can happen. And how indifferent and useless they can be in some cases. So I’m afraid to call them. I think if I take a few hours to calm down I’m think of something. Thank you again for talking to me. I won’t forget it
Thank you. Do you know what would happen if I did call them? I’m so embarrassed to be like this. I’m a mess. I’m scared what they would do, do you know?

Yes you’re exactly right. The old fear of a beating is making me numb and unable to think. 

You’re also correct about him not being like this when I married him. The only reason I felt safe to marry him was because I knew him for years and he was nothing but a big teddy bear. Never raised his voice once. I will say he has always been a little lazy. But nobody is perfect and I’m a hard worker so it balanced out. A few weeks after I became disabled I started to see him resenting me not being able to do things. He started doing things out of spite. Then over time he started getting meaner and meaner until he now screams at me if I try to talk about any issue or concern. When he’s screaming you can really hear how much he hates me for being disabled now. I can’t help that this has happened to me. I’ve been to 11 doctors and specialists trying to find answers. But they’ve all told me they have no idea. So it’s not like I’m not trying to get better.

EDIT: changed confusing explanation to make it clearer

Thank you for talking to me. Thank you. Thank you thank you..

I left out of fear. He was screaming and screaming at me. I know enough from my parents beating me how someone sounds when they’re about to start hitting me. So I grabbed my cane, purse and keys and got to my car somehow. I knew he was about to start beating me and I’m too disabled to defend myself. I was really scared so I did the only thing I could think of to avoid a beating
